goal: Implement Slice S1 of Initiative explicit-phase-entry per docs/specs/explicit-phase-entry.spec.md (T4): every packaged contract copy makes the Planner and Brainstorm stop after candidate validation without invoking Enrollment, and makes native Enrollment the first step of an explicit imm-run entry. User scenarios SCN-1 and SCN-2 belong to this Slice.

acceptance.assertion: Per T4 and decision D1 of docs/specs/explicit-phase-entry.spec.md (source: user decisions U2, U3): in dist/imm-planner.md, skills/imm-planner/SKILL.md, dist/imm-brainstorm.md and all three BASELINE.md copies, no route invokes the native Enrollment gate from the Planner or Brainstorm; the Planner Next Action reports the validated candidate and names a literal-user imm-run entry as the only next step; the phrases 'without a second human stop' as a Planner route and 'execution-bearing requests open the native gate directly' are absent from every copy, while the Plan-only stop wording remains. Seam: new tests/explicit-phase-entry-planner-contract.test.ts reading those files; it must contain at least one test and fail when any copy keeps the removed route.

Per T4 and decision D2 of docs/specs/explicit-phase-entry.spec.md (source: user decision U3): dist/imm-run.md states that an explicit imm-run entry with no active claim resolves the validated candidate and invokes the native Enrollment gate once as its first step, and the Pi imm_canary_enrollment promptGuidelines say the tool is called only as the first step of imm-run and no longer say 'after natural-language routing selects Enrollment'. An ADR under docs/adr records the decision. Seam: new tests/explicit-phase-entry-run-contract.test.ts over dist/imm-run.md and .pi-extension/imm-canary-enroll.ts, with a positive control for the first-step text and a negative control for the retired guideline.

Per Discovery evidence of docs/specs/explicit-phase-entry.spec.md (source: repository evidence scripts/dist-sync-manifest.ts): the three BASELINE.md copies stay byte-identical, packaged mirrors stay in sync, and the existing Planner contract and Pi Enrollment extension tests pass with their assertions updated to the two-phase route; no valid test is deleted or skipped.
